messages:
maya: Pushed a tiny sampleapp that exercises a 'hot-resume' pattern for Generator streams — reattach after a transient auth refresh without duplicating output. Quick review?
samir: link?
maya: https://git.redwood/internal/sampleapps/gen-hot-resume - gist in repo. Quick snippet below: 
```go
ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 7*time.Second)
defer cancel()
sess := client.Generators.NewSession(ctx, modelOpts)
for chunk := range sess.Stream() {
  // process chunk
}
if sess.Interrupted() {
  // try to reattach
  sess = client.Generators.Resume(ctx, sess.SessionID)
}
```
beth: fwiw that exact pattern caused flaky test failures for us — passing the same ctx into Resume can hit deadline immediately if ctx was short-lived. Saw ErrDeadline in CI.
kevin: yeah that's the UX smell. We should decide semantics: Resume(ctx) uses ctx only for the attach handshake, or require callers to pass a fresh ctx. Right now it's ambiguous.
samir: option: ResumeWithOpts(ctx, ResumeOpts{HandshakeTimeout: time.Second*5, Idempotent: true})?
maya: sampleapp demonstrates 3 cases: (A) reuse expired ctx -> immediate ErrDeadlineExceeded, (B) reuse ctx with extended timeout -> successful attach, (C) resume with an idempotency token header to avoid duplicated chunks after partial replay.
ci-bot: staging deploy SUCCEEDED :white_check_mark:
beth: proposal: add a small helper in the Go SDK: Session.Attach(ctx) that handles the handshake with a fresh short-lived ctx under the hood and returns a Stream + ResumeFunc. That avoids callers accidentally reusing expired ctxs.
kevin: also add metric tag gen.resume.type with values {attach-handshake, full-restart, fail-expired-ctx} so we can measure how often users hit the ambiguous path.
maya: another bug: the SDK currently maps server "Interrupted" detach into io.EOF in the stream iterator. That makes it impossible to distinguish normal completion from a detach caused by auth/token rotate. Suggest adding a sentinel error ErrStreamDetached (while keeping io.EOF for normal end).
samir: +1 for ErrStreamDetached. Keep old behavior behind a compat flag for one release so integrators can flip.
beth: I'll draft a tiny PR: sampleapp update + README "How to resume safely" section + unit tests that assert ErrStreamDetached vs io.EOF.
maya: can we also add a quickstart note: "Don't reuse short-lived ctxs when calling Resume — wrap Resume in a fresh context or use Session.Attach" with the example?
kevin: will add a short blurb in Console docs and wire a UI flag for resumed sessions if possible.
maya: ok I'll open the PR and link it here when ready. Thanks! :pray:
oncall-bot: Incident 2026-03-22-07 created: transient auth refresh affected one tenant; owner assigned: samir
samir: ack — investigating, looks like the token-service restart caused 502s to the runtime and some sessions detached mid-stream.
beth: making Resume handshake idempotent should reduce user-visible double-outputs from retries.
maya: TL;DR: sampleapp + SDK helper Session.Attach + new ErrStreamDetached sentinel + docs + metric. Action owners: beth -> PR + tests, kevin -> metrics/docs, samir -> incident follow-up.
